## File: facebookresearch_parlai/projects/seeker/utils.py

Prompts

```
['extract named entities and noun chunks from a sentence using spaCy', 'calculate F1 overlap between a prediction string and a list of gold labels', 'calculate F1 score with entity overlap between prediction and gold items', 'remove a matching title from the beginning of a text document', 'use the SearchDecision enum to choose always, never, or compute search strategy']
```

Usage

```
{'extract_entities_from_text': 'extract named entities and noun chunks from a sentence using spaCy', 'calc_f1_msmarco_score': 'calculate F1 overlap between a prediction string and a list of gold labels', 'calc_f1_msc_score': 'calculate F1 score with entity overlap between prediction and gold items', 'remove_title_from_text': 'remove a matching title from the beginning of a text document', 'use_searchdecision_enum': 'use the SearchDecision enum to choose always, never, or compute search strategy'}
```
